records.text: Owens alleged Turning Point USA tried to scrub its affiliation with Dodd from the internet, citing broken links and a local letter by Cora Nichols from which she said the words “Club America” had been removed. She said she was assuming a friend had made the edit.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Also, you should know that they tried to scrub their affiliation from the Internet. So there were a lot of broken links as we were trying to hunt down this information. ... Because if you type in, as we did, Bonners Ferry TPUSA president trying to figure to confirm that that was him, the first hit that you get is a local news article where they had initially placed an ad of sorts and they got a friend to go back and just scrub the words Club America from the article. Look at this. ... Assuming it's a friend who did this, so it's like she's kind of placing this, this ad in letters to the editor: 'Hello there, my name is Cora Nichols and I'm the vice president of Bonners Ferry's local'—that did say Club America—'homeschool hub. I wanted to share some of the recent activities that our hub has been involved in.' They just took it out. ... They just took out their name so that they could pretend that they were not affiliated and the people would not see this hit.

records.text: In a local letter read by Owens, Cora Nichols described herself as vice president of Bonners Ferry’s local homeschool hub. Owens interjected that the text previously said Club America; that edit allegation is Owens’s, not Nichols’s.
